description: Configuration and build script for UEFI EDK2 Firmware targeting Arm platforms, including build steps, environment setup, dependencies, and deployment procedures.

methods.name: do_configure
methods.description: Prepares build configuration by modifying tools_def.template with sed.

methods.name: do_compile
methods.description: Compiles the firmware by adjusting makefiles, copying configuration templates, and invoking build commands.

methods.name: do_install
methods.description: Installs the built firmware binary into the designated directory.

methods.name: do_deploy
methods.description: Deploys firmware images to the deployment directory.
